params.body:
## What changes for the dealer

**"Mijn aangeboden wagens" shows the next step of every bidding as the button of the row** (desktop row and phone card), the way the own-stock list shows its funnel button:

| state | Bod cell | primary action |
|---|---|---|
| bidding open | highest bid, bidder | Biedingen (view) |
| closed, bids, no winner, within the 15 days | highest bid, "nog niet toegewezen" | **Bod toewijzen** (opens the bids page) |
| closed, past the window | "termijn om toe te wijzen voorbij" | Biedingen |
| winner assigned | "Toegewezen aan KTC Cars", the winner's amount | **Vrijgeven voor afhaling** (ui.confirm, then the existing `setcontrolled` route, reload) |
| released | idem | **Afgehaald & beoordelen** (opens the rating modal of #373 for the winner) |
| delivered | idem | chip **Afgehandeld** next to the Biedingen link |

**The bids page** keeps "Bod toewijzen" per bid until a winner exists; then the winner is marked and the other rows have no toggle. The two other toggle columns are gone. A state line above the table says "Toegewezen aan …, € …", "Vrijgegeven voor afhaling op …" (or still to release) and whether it was collected, and carries the same next-step button.

**The sequence is a rule on the server, not a disabled checkbox.** `setControlled` refuses without a winner (422 with a message) and a second release changes nothing (one control date, one mail; before it reset the date and mailed again). `addExportBuyerVote` (422) and `storeExportBuyerVote` (redirect with the reason) refuse before the release. The `wonBidding` fixture of `RatingScreenTest` is released now, since the rating is the third step.

**Bidding offer sort (Shane's ask in the bidding area).** The default already was end date ascending (`BiddingOfferBrowser::$orderBy = 'end_asc'`, R B1-2.9), but the fixed second key was `id desc`, so within one end date the newest bidding sat on top. The second key now follows the direction of the first: soonest end date first, oldest bidding first on the same day. A chosen sort still wins.

## Rules and finding

- R B1-5.4, B1-5.6, B1-5.8 rewritten for the sequence and where each step lives; new R B1-5.13 (the overview's step button); R B1-2.9 says the second sort key. Intro of B1-5 updated.
- Finding `2026-09-15-biedingsopvolging-drie-schakelaars-per-bod.md` (opgelost, beslist: Shane): a dealer who skipped the release cannot mark collected any more without releasing first.

## Tests

`BiddingFunnelTest` (9 tests): the right primary action per state in row and card, the winner named, release needs a winner and happens once, the rating needs the release, the bids page before and after a winner, the offer order. Filter `Bidding|Export|Rating|Voting|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|HandlerWiring|AlpineExpression|CompiledViews|StylesheetSyntax|FrenchTranslations`: OK (94 tests, 1222 assertions).

## Screenshots

`.playwright-mcp/bidding-funnel/` in the worktree: overview at 1440 and 390 (all five states), detail pages for assign / release / pickup / done, the release confirm.

Built on #450 (two visible buttons per row): the actions cell wraps onto a second line so the ⋯ stays inside the card at 1440 px.
params.title: Bidding follow-up happens from the overview, one step at a time
